Agletras is a research and intelligence startup that systematically investigates public records, evaluates evidence, and connects relevant findings to deliver structured, decision-ready intelligence. Where automated tools return noisy results and unverified claims, Agletras proves ground truth with attributed source citations and human analytical rigor.
Built on an uncompromising commitment to empirical evidence and analytical rigor.

, along the way, we experienced firsthand how even the best security teams were overwhelmed by growing attack surfaces and constant noise. It became clear that manual testing couldn’t scale. Our research practice combines structured information harvesting with disciplined analytical verification, ensuring our intelligence dossiers remain fully attributed, transparent, and decision-ready.
